title: Writing / Style / Formatting
slide_intent: Introduce formatting as a visual choice so writers recognize that presentation changes how copy is read.
strategic_value: Separating visual treatment from grammar can help Duolingo explain why its formatting conventions are brand-specific.
demonstration: A narrow separator pairs the Formatting heading at left with a short explanation at right; it contains no worked examples.
practical_value: Distinguish a presentation convention from a grammatical requirement before applying the following rules.

content_islands.name: Framing sentence
content_islands.spec: Align the brief explanation at right, describing formatting as visual design for copy.

reference_purposes.Intent: The sentence explicitly frames formatting as the visual treatment of copy rather than grammar.
